scripts.dev:gateway: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run dev --workspace @aspectloop/gateway-api
scripts.dev:extraction: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run dev --workspace @aspectloop/extraction-service
scripts.dev:correction: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run dev --workspace @aspectloop/correction-service
scripts.build: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:gateway: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run build --workspace @aspectloop/gateway-api
scripts.build:extraction: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run build --workspace @aspectloop/extraction-service
scripts.build:correction: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run build --workspace @aspectloop/correction-service
scripts.graphql:generate: npm run graphql:generate:gateway && npm run graphql:generate:web
scripts.local:db:generate:gateway: bash infra/local/scripts/local-compose.sh exec -w /app/apps/gateway-api gateway-api npm run db:generate:local --
scripts.type-check: npm run build:backend-platform && npm run type-check --workspace @aspectloop/web && tsc -p apps/gateway-api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extraction-service/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/correction-service/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint:ci && npm run type-check && npm run graphql:check && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:integration:run
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run build && npm run test:backend:run && npm run test:e2e:mock
